items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I had a place... we'd come over there and I think his favorite that he liked to listen to a lot was Afternoon of a Faun... All the Debussy and --

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, fine appreciation for music. Fine. Of course, I have sat with him at nights, nothing else would do, we would go over -- I had a suite in the hotel there and he had a little joint over in a place called the Billinghurst. They used to call them flea bags, and a lot of the musicians stayed there, but how long are musicians in their rooms? Very seldom.

But anyway I had a place, because I had to have a place to work, so we'd come over there and I think his favorite that he liked to listen to a lot was Afternoon of a Faun. We used to listen to that a lot and then the Firebird, of course, "La Mer." and Mamore. All the Debussy and --
